_help.about: Cloak colors for cloaked folk (CloakedFigure). Every figure outside the opening camp rolls its cloak from `colors` at random, and its fringe (the hem band and trim) from `colors` too, never the same as the cloak, so camps keep looking fresh. The opening camp's pair keeps the designer's pick (the elder ochre yellow, the hunter madder red: Encampment.OPENING_FAMILIES). avoid: cloak and fringe pairs no one else wears (the player's own look: indigo with a rust-orange fringe). Colors are sRGB hex; the shading of the cloth is kept.
